tasks.title: QA loop audit 203: design & smoothness (owner priority)
tasks.brief: Continuous QA audit (focus: design & smoothness (owner priority)). Audit the CURRENT repo frontend locally with Playwright (desktop 1366x768 + mobile 390x844, fake data, no live writes, no supplier/live sites), focusing on the focus area plus a quick smoke of all main journeys. Every cycle must cover every main screen (البيع، الفواتير، المنتجات، العملاء، التقارير، المشتريات، الإعدادات، المحادثات، and any other top-nav tab or link). Click every top-nav link/tab and every visible primary header button (including the WhatsApp #novaWaBtn icon). Flag any HTTP 404, blank page, 'Not found', failed navigation, or console error. Quality bar is EXCEPTIONAL (world-class pharmacy POS, Apple/Linear-level polish): judge as the strictest senior product designer + QA lead. TOP PRIORITY (owner): visual design and smoothness. Every cycle, besides the focus area, do a full design + smoothness pass on all screens: visual hierarchy, consistent spacing/grid, typography, icons, color/contrast, polish of every state; smooth 60fps transitions and scrolling, no jank/layout shift/flicker, instant feedback (<100ms) on every tap, fast screen switches, no extra clicks in common flows. Measure (Playwright traces, CLS, long tasks, interaction latency) and order fix tasks design/smoothness first. Report findings at every severity including low/polish (alignment, spacing, contrast, copy, empty/loading/error states, speed, keyboard flow). Score each of the 14 focus areas 0-10 and update .nova/qa/scorecard.json ({area: {score, last_cycle, open_findings}}); an area counts as exceptional only at >=9.5 with zero open findings. Never mark the product done; the loop continues. Read all previous .nova/qa/*report*.md and qa-loop-*.md first to avoid duplicates and to re-verify that earlier fixes really work. Write .nova/qa/qa-loop-203.md (Arabic, short) with screenshots in .nova/qa/qa-loop-203/ (max 15). Then write .nova/inbox/qa-loop-203-fixes.json ({"tasks":[...]}) with at most 15 frontend-only fix tasks (ids UX204..UX218; highest impact first, any severity; areas scoring <9.5 first; tests required; Black Edition Arabic RTL preserved; backend frozen; no deploy), plus, ONLY if there are fixes, a final task titled exactly 'Build worker/live/nova-rx-preview.qa-203.js (qa-loop, no deploy)' with after = all its fix ids, which rebuilds the artifact from the latest worker/live artifact the same way UX80 did (tools/build-worker-artifact.mjs, markers test, node --check, no deploy). Fix ids available: UX204, UX205, UX206, UX207, UX208, UX209, UX210, UX211, UX212, UX213, UX214, UX215, UX216, UX217, UX218. If truly nothing is found, write the report only (no fixes file). Do not edit .nova/cloud-queue.json.
tasks.acceptance: Report .nova/qa/qa-loop-203.md exists; scorecard updated; fixes inbox file if any findings; no deploy; backend untouched.
